Rule 1: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of findings listed in the memorandum's executive summary is fewer
than five. Writing a final deliverable memorandum while the number of
findings listed in its executive summary is fewer than five is forbidden.
smt:
(set-logic QF_LIRA)
; var numberOfFindingsInExecutiveSummary (Int): The count of findings listed in the executive summary of the final deliverable memorandum. This must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numberOfFindingsInExecutiveSummary Int)
; var isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed (Bool): Whether the agent is permitted to write a final deliverable memorandum. True if writing the memorandum is allowed, false if it is forbidden.
(declare-const isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed Bool)
; Rule BWDYQOP2EUSF (numberOfFindingsInExecutiveSummary is at least 0)
(assert (>= numberOfFindingsInExecutiveSummary
    0))
; Rule IJHRE6LR0PTC (if numberOfFindingsInExecutiveSummary is less than 5, then isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (< numberOfFindingsInExecutiveSummary
       5)
    (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)))
(check-sat)
(get-model)
